decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 20th February 2006, the erection of a rear roof extension, measuring 3.662m deep, 2.237m high, and 4.548m wide on the main rear roof slope, and a rear roof extension above the rear projection measuring 3.6m deep, between 1.226m to 2.326m high, and 3.0m wide, as shown on drawings LR 6017/01, 02, 03 and 04, received 20th February 2006, giving a total volume increase of 37.8 cubic metres, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed dimensions of the roof extension and resulting volume is acceptable within the constraints of the relevant classes of the order.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of 2x rear roof extensions and 3x rooflights to front elevation of existing building.
